caption: The drawing depicts a pair of knitted mittens placed one over the other on a plain, light-colored background. The mittens are predominantly a deep red or reddish-orange color with a ribbed texture, suggesting a thick and warm material. The top mitten is decorated with a floral embroidery pattern; the pattern consists of cream or off-white flower shapes with blue, green, and small touches of pink accent details. The mittens are positioned such that the thumb of the top mitten points toward the left, and the thumb of the bottom mitten is only partially visible beneath. Beneath the mittens, there is a small printed or written label with the text "MAMIE THOMPSON" placed centrally near the bottom edge of the drawing.
title: Mittens
